evidence: Matches Utils/log/libs label and modifies BCLog logging sanitization in src/logging.cpp.
rationale: Prevents terminal injection vulnerabilities by escaping UTF-8 C1 control codes (U+0080 to U+009F) in BCLog::LogEscapeMessage. Without this fix, untrusted logged strings can emit CSI, OSC, or DCS sequences in VTE-based terminal emulators like GNOME Terminal, allowing untrusted input to drive or corrupt the display.
